title: Catch the Big Fish
description: Spot and collect three matching 3D sea creatures from a tumbling ocean heap before the timer expires, chaining quick matches for combo stars.
controls: Tap three matching 3D fish or marine toys to collect them into the bottom slots and clear every target before time runs out.

zh-CN.title: 抓大鱼
zh-CN.description: 抓大鹅同款 3D 物理堆叠找物三消：在满满一盆呆萌海洋生物中眼疾手快凑齐三连消除，限时冲击高星。
zh-CN.controls: 点击堆叠中的同款 3D 小鱼或海洋玩具收入槽位，集齐三个自动消除；注意别把槽位塞满。
